title: Marketing Executive
company: Work Lyf Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Marketing Executive

Work Lyf Group are recruiting for a Marketing Executive on behalf of our client based in Stoke-on-Trent. This is an exciting opportunity for an energetic, creative and outgoing marketing professional to join a growing logistics and supply chain business.

This is a highly visible, front-facing role focused on communications, social media, email marketing, content creation and events. The successful candidate will play a key role in strengthening the company's brand presence and supporting business growth.

Salary

30,000 - 36,000 per annum

Location

Stoke-on-Trent

Job Type

Permanent, Full-Time

The Role

As Marketing Executive, you will be responsible for creating engaging content, managing social media channels, supporting PR and events and delivering effective marketing campaigns. This role offers genuine opportunities for development within a growing business.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan, create and deliver email marketing campaigns to existing and prospective customers.
- Manage and grow social media platforms, particularly LinkedIn.
- Produce engaging internal communications and company updates.
- Develop customer case studies and marketing content to support business development activities.
- Organise and coordinate events, exhibitions and networking opportunities.
- Support directors and senior stakeholders with their personal LinkedIn presence.
- Create marketing materials, graphics and content using platforms such as Adobe Creative Suite and Canva.
- Utilise AI tools to assist with content creation, campaign planning and reporting.
- Monitor campaign performance and provide regular marketing reports.
- Ensure all marketing communications remain consistent with brand guidelines.

The Ideal Candidate

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience within a marketing, communications or social media role.
- Strong knowledge of LinkedIn and social media marketing.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience creating engaging content across multiple channels.
- Confident, outgoing and customer-facing personality.
- Well organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
- Comfortable working closely with senior management and directors.

Desirable Skills
- Experience with Adobe Creative Suite and Canva.
- Knowledge of HTML email design.
- Experience using AI tools within marketing campaigns.
- Event planning and PR experience.
- Previous experience within a B2 B environment.
- Understanding of logistics, supply chain or transport sectors.

What they Offer
- Competitive salary of 30,000 - 36,000.
- Opportunity to join a growing and ambitious business.
- Genuine career progression and development opportunities.
- Collaborative and supportive working environment.
- Opportunity to shape and influence the company's marketing strategy.

Apply Now

If you're a driven, creative and ambitious marketing professional looking for your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Project Coordinator

Location: Stoke-on-Trent
Salary: 25,000- 28,000 per annum
Job Type: Full-Time Permanent
Working Arrangement: Hybrid Working Available

Project Coordinator - Branding, Graphics & Signage

Are you an organised and proactive Project Coordinator looking for your next opportunity?

We're recruiting on behalf of an established business specialising in commercial graphics, branding and visual communications. They're looking for a Project Coordinator to join their Customer Service team, supporting the successful delivery of a variety of projects across sectors including fleet, rail and architectural branding.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous Project Coordination experience who enjoys managing multiple tasks, working with different departments and ensuring projects run smoothly from start to finish.

Experience within the signage, print, graphics or branding sectors would be advantageous, but the key requirement is a strong background in coordinating projects and keeping work on track.

The Role

Working closely with Project Managers, customers and internal departments, you'll coordinate the day-to-day activities required to deliver projects efficiently, ensuring materials, labour, schedules and customer requirements are managed effectively.

Key Responsibilities:
- Coordinate projects from initial planning through to completion, ensuring deadlines and budgets are met.
- Work closely with Project Managers to understand project specifications and customer requirements.
- Liaise with customers to provide updates, resolve queries and maintain excellent service.
- Coordinate labour, materials and resources with internal departments.
- Monitor project progress, identify potential issues and help implement effective solutions.
- Maintain accurate project records, documentation and schedules.
- Support the coordination of larger, more complex projects and programmes of work.
- Handle customer complaints professionally, escalating issues where appropriate.
- Work collaboratively with internal teams to ensure projects are delivered efficiently and to the required standard.
- Identify opportunities for process improvements and enhanced customer service.

About You

We're looking for someone who is organised, detail-oriented and confident coordinating multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Essential skills and experience:
- Previous experience in a Project Coordinator or similar project support role.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads and manage competing deadlines.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Confident liaising with customers, suppliers and internal departments.
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
- Good problem-solving skills and the ability to take a proactive approach to resolving issues.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records.
- A team player who can also work independently and use their initiative.

Desirable experience:
- Experience within signage, graphics, print, branding, visual communications or a related industry.
- An understanding of production processes, materials or installation requirements.
- Experience coordinating projects involving multiple teams, resources and deadlines.
- An awareness of health and safety requirements.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of 25,000- 28,000 per annum, depending on experience.
- Hybrid working arrangements available.
- Full-time, permanent employment.
- Ongoing training and development.
- Contributory pension scheme.
- Generous annual leave, plus an additional volunteering day.
- Free onsite parking.
- Employee discount scheme with access to over 800 retailers.
- Employee assistance programme.
- Cycle-to-work scheme.
- Company social events and wellbeing initiatives.
- A friendly and supportive working environment.

Interested?

If you have previous Project Coordination experience and are looking for a role where you can develop your skills while supporting the delivery of exciting branding and graphics projects, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more about this opportunity.

title: Recruitment Administrator
description:
Recruitment Administrator Office-based in Stoke on Trent Monday to Friday, 9:30am to 2:30pm (flexible) 15 per hour Structured hours with strong work-life balance in a busy recruitment environment

Meridian Business Support are looking to appoint a Recruitment Administrator to support day-to-day operations within a well established branch. This position plays a key part in ensuring payroll accuracy and smooth onboarding for a large candidate workforce.

As a Recruitment Administrator, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate records and delivering timely payroll processing within a fast-moving environment:
- Process weekly payroll, ensuring deadlines are consistently met
- Collate, check and verify timesheets with a high level of accuracy
- Calculate holiday pay, overtime, bonuses and adjustments using Excel and internal systems
- Maintain and update candidate records within the CRM system
- Enter new starters and ensure all personal and assignment data is recorded correctly
- Issue assignment details, contracts and relevant onboarding documentation to candidates
- Answer the phone, and responding to queries from both candidates and clients

To be successful in this Recruitment Administrator role, you will demonstrate:
- Excellent communication skills including via the phone and email
- Strong Excel skills, including confidence with calculations and data management
- Previous experience using CRM systems or recruitment databases
- Excellent attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and compliance
- Ability to manage high-volume administrative tasks and meet strict deadlines
- Experience within payroll, recruitment administration or a similar coordination role is desirable

Benefits and working environment
- 15 per hour
- Consistent weekday hours with no weekend work
- Office-based role offering structure and routine
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Possible Opportunity to develop within a growing recruitment business

If you are a detail-focused administrator looking for a busy and structured position where your organisational and Excel skills will be valued, this Recruitment Administrator position offers a stable and rewarding next step.

Meridian Business Support is a recruitment specialist acting on behalf of our client as an Employment Agency for this vacancy.

title: Sales Support Administrator (Part Time)
description:
A well-established and leading software platform with its head office in Stoke-on-Trent is looking to appoint a Part-Time Sales Support Administrator to join its growing commercial team. This is a great opportunity for an organised, personable administrator who enjoys being at the heart of a busy sales function and wants the flexibility that part-time hours bring.
20 hours a week
Salary: up to £30000 pro rata
The business is going through an exciting period of growth, and this role has been created to give the sales team the day-to-day support they need to keep momentum going. You'll be the reliable go-to person keeping quotes, orders, CRM records and customer communications ticking along nicely behind the scenes.
If you thrive on variety, take pride in getting the details right and enjoy a role where no two days look quite the same, this one is worth a closer look.
What you'll be doing:
- Supporting the sales team with day-to-day admin, including raising quotes, processing orders and preparing sales documentation
- Acting as a first point of contact for customer enquiries responding promptly and professionally by phone and email
- Keeping the CRM up to date with accurate customer, prospect and pipeline information
- Coordinating diaries, meetings and product demos for the sales team
- Producing sales reports, activity summaries and pipeline updates for management
- Liaising with colleagues across installations, support and finance to keep the customer journey seamless
- Managing incoming leads, logging them into the CRM and ensuring timely follow-up
- Supporting proposal preparation and contract paperwork where needed
- Providing general administrative cover across the wider sales function

What we're looking for:
- Previous experience in a sales administration, sales support or commercial admin role
- Confident communicator clear and professional, both written and verbal
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to juggle competing priorities without dropping the ball
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy with data
- Comfortable working with CRM systems and confident across Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
- Customer-focused, approachable and professional
- Experience within a SaaS, software or technology business would be a real plus

For immediate consideration, apply with your CV or call for more details
